task:
Goal: Implement GitHub-parity footnotes in the Inkuno editor, per the approved spec below. This is new-feature work in a shared area — be additive, do not remove anything.

SPEC (from plan scout, normative):
- Syntax (GitHub exact): ref [^label] inline; def [^label]: text with ≤3-space indent, indented continuation lines; label = 1+ chars, no ], no whitespace-only, no | (protects tables.rs bars()); match case-insensitively, display first-seen casing; refs/defs outside code spans/fences/front-matter only. Undefined [^x] stays literal/unclickable. Duplicate defs: first wins.
- Parser (src/logic/markdown/mod.rs): add Link::Footnote(String) variant (flows through existing consumers; compiler lists match sites). New footnote_ref() mirroring web_link/image (guard: not ![^…]). New footnote_def() + document pass footnotes() -> Vec<FootDef{label, display (1-based by first-ref order), at, refs}> mirroring index()/all_comments, fence/front-matter aware. Cheap count_footnotes() pre-scan for the layout hot path.
- Styling: in links_and_comments(), mark [^ and ] DIM, label LINK (accent+underline); layout downgrades UNDEFINED refs to literal (per-line fns can't know defined-ness — do it in layout, keep flags() signature unchanged).
- Layout (src/views/editor/layout.rs): cache foot defs next to fences; add foot version u64 to LayoutKey/Laid + per-line style id hash (def add/remove restyles distant lines — stale reuse is the #1 risk). Hide gate: label ranges kept-readable (extend kept closure), brackets DIM so they elide off-live. subs map needs no new machinery (elision-only). Tables: render LINK color but NO bracket elision (phase-3 "tables keep source" rule, test asserts subs==0 on table rows) — share one helper footnote_flags() called from both layout.rs and grid.rs cell shaping.
- Navigation: Ctrl+click ref -> jump(def.at) via cursor.rs jump; Ctrl+click def label -> jump refs[0], cycling on repeat (store last index in Editor). Run the footnote arm BEFORE mouse_down sets revealed (mouse.rs:627-628) or reset after. NO inserted ↩ glyph v1 (insertion path untested) — clickable label only. hand_at cursor: include footnote ranges.
- Print (src/ui/print.rs inline()): render label, hide brackets, no urls entry; defs print in place; document the no-collected-section limitation in book/src/writing.md alongside other limits.
- Sharing (src/logic/sharing.rs inline()): [^label] passes through literal; add cases to sharing_plain_text_rules.
- Docs: update book/src/writing.md:21-34 (replace "footnotes kept as you typed them") + markdown_renderer.md undecided-syntax items.
- Tests: mod.rs unit tests (parse, non-collision with [[wiki]]/[x](…)/checkboxes, code exclusion, undefined split, dup defs, case, multi-ref order, continuations); layout gpui test mirroring markers_hide_until test (hide off-live, reveal on click, subs round-trip); reuse test (add def -> refs restyle); grid substitutions both-ways; sharing rules; export_pdf footnote case; e2e Ctrl+click jumps + multi-ref cycling + undefined no-op.

OVERLAP RULES (sibling crews own removals — you are additive-only): do NOT remove table-grid code in grid.rs (trim-tables crew owns it), do NOT touch canvas/diagram/embed/nav/sync/update/print-removal areas, Cargo.toml, or shared registries beyond REPORT-only file:line notes. If layout.rs/grid.rs regions conflict conceptually with the table-trim, keep your changes additive and REPORT it.
